svg.title: An agent shops on a merchant website with a Visa card: TAP browsing and payer signatures, a VIC token, verification at the CDN
svg.desc: Sequence diagram: An agent shops on a merchant website with a Visa card: TAP browsing and payer signatures, a VIC token, verification at the CDN. 7 participants: Consumer, AI agent (Agent Provider), Visa Intelligent Commerce, CDN (Site Protection Provider), Visa key store, Merchant website, and Acquirer, Visa network and issuer. 16 steps, 13 crossing a trust boundary, 11 failure branches. Based on several protocols TAP spec, unversioned (read 2026-10-11) VIC API client in visa/ai (2026-09-30) (2025-10-14). Step 1: Consumer to AI agent (Agent Provider): Ask the agent to buy an item. Step 2: AI agent (Agent Provider) to Visa Intelligent Commerce: POST /vacp/v1/cards (card enrollment). This step crosses a trust boundary. If Step-up verification fails: No agent-specific token is provisioned. Step 3: AI agent (Agent Provider) to CDN (Site Protection Provider): GET product page, signed with tag agent-browser-auth. This step crosses a trust boundary. If A checkout enabler or proxy strips the signature headers: The request arrives untagged and is treated as an unknown bot. Step 4: CDN (Site Protection Provider) to Visa key store: Fetch the key for keyid. This step crosses a trust boundary. If No key for keyid, or the key has expired: Block the request TAP has no revocation list or key status endpoint. Step 5: CDN (Site Protection Provider) to CDN (Site Protection Provider): Verify tag, fields, window, nonce and signature. If Neither agent-browser-auth nor agent-payer-auth in Signature-Input: Not signed by a trusted agent block or apply ordinary bot policy. If Missing field, window over 8 minutes, reused nonce or failed signature: Block the request. Step 6: CDN (Site Protection Provider) to Merchant website: Forward as a verified browsing agent. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 7: Merchant website to AI agent (Agent Provider): 200 product page with final cost. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 8: AI agent (Agent Provider) to Visa Intelligent Commerce: POST /vacp/v1/instructions (Payment Instruction). This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 9: Consumer to Visa Intelligent Commerce: Approve the instruction with a passkey. This step crosses a trust boundary. If The consumer declines or the passkey check fails: No credentials can be retrieved nothing is charged. Step 10: AI agent (Agent Provider) to Visa Intelligent Commerce: POST /vacp/v1/instructions/ instructionId /credentials. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 11: AI agent (Agent Provider) to CDN (Site Protection Provider): POST checkout, signed with tag agent-payer-auth, with agenticConsumer and agenticPaymentContainer. This step crosses a trust boundary. If The body is altered in transit: The header signature still verifies only the body object signatures can catch it. Step 12: CDN (Site Protection Provider) to Merchant website: Verify the payer signature at the edge, forward. This step crosses a trust boundary. If The signature window has passed while the agent was waiting for the passkey: Block the agent signs a fresh request. Step 13: Merchant website to Merchant website: Verify the body objects and the credential hash. If Payment container fields missing, nonce mismatch or bad signature: Should not be used for payment. If The merchant's hash of the key-entered card data differs from the payment credential hash: The specification says the merchant should decline. Step 14: Merchant website to Acquirer, Visa network and issuer: Authorize the card payment. This step crosses a trust boundary. If The issuer declines: An ordinary card decline TAP has no role. Step 15: Merchant website to AI agent (Agent Provider): Order confirmation. This step crosses a trust boundary. Step 16: AI agent (Agent Provider) to Visa Intelligent Commerce: POST /vacp/v1/instructions/ instructionId /confirmations. This step crosses a trust boundary.
